description: ha-snopud: Home Assistant custom integration. The base policy covers the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions (hassfest and the HACS action follow their master/main branch by digest), the ruff version passed to astral-sh/ruff-action in tests.yml, and the pytest-homeassistant-custom-component pin in requirements_test.txt, which moves with each Home Assistant release. The building blocks add the knope pin in knope-prepare.yml / knope-release.yml and the Simple English plugin pin in claude-review.yml, both held for review. The pre-commit manager is enabled for the hooks in .pre-commit-config.yaml.

packageRules.description: Group the two ruff pins so the local hook and CI lint with the same version: the `version:` input of astral-sh/ruff-action in tests.yml (depName `ruff`, read by the github-actions manager) and the astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit hook rev. Without this rule they land in two PRs (github-actions and pre-commit (non-major)) and can drift. This rule only regroups. The base auto-merge policy still applies.
